transcription.verification_note: New official TNLA Assembly Debates evidence dated 7 March 1973 permits evidence-based recovery of text physically missing from the booklet scan. Strict page-by-page revalidation has now closed scans 4-5, 10-11 and 20 with booklet line breaks preserved and no contextual guessing. Scan 5 corrected the earlier bulk join before Ponnappa Nadar; scan 10 restored the cropped `க்` in `நில வரியைக் குறைத்தோம்`; scan 20 restored 33 right-gutter fragments/punctuation across 40 source-loss positions and corrected the booklet-visible `வரியையெல்லாம்` reading. Because canonical Tamil has changed after the prior Gate-E/G/H release, Tamil and English fidelity plus release integrity require revalidation after crop recovery is complete.

gate_g_corrections: scan p.5→6: reduced unsupported agency inflation from 'had me locked up' to source-close wording that Ponnappa Nadar was among those who supported keeping Karunanidhi locked up while the Assembly was conducted.

scan p.7: removed a reversed negation and restored the source position that the Finance Commission itself should take Plan expenditure into account and make recommendations, while the Planning Commission may provide year-to-year assistance under Finance Commission principles.
scan p.8: removed the unsupported wording that the Planning Commission should perform 'no such function' and restored a source-close rendering of the compressed final sentence.
scan p.9: changed 'public welfare' to 'public health' for `மக்கள் நல் வாழ்வு` in the three-department budget comparison.

scan p.17: changed 'Ordinary people may not worry about it' to the source-certain 'Ordinary people will not worry about it' for `பாமர மக்கள் கவலைப்படமாட்டார்கள்`, preserving Kalaignar's categorical rhetorical contrast.

scan p.19: removed the Gate-F editorial distancing phrase 'what the source describes as' and rendered the source's unusual `இரண்டு புள்ளி ... இழுபறி நிலை` directly as a 'dragging two-point position', without externally correcting the anomalous economic claim.
scan p.24: changed 'failed to increase generation' to the source-faithful accusation 'not producing electricity' for `நாம் உற்பத்தி செய்யவில்லை`.

scan p.27: removed the reconstructed place-name 'Cuddalore' from a crop-damaged phrase; the verified Tamil preserves physical loss there, so English now retains only the supported clause plus `⟦scan-crop⟧`.
scan p.28: removed the hedging editorial phrase 'perhaps thinking' and rendered the source's direct sarcastic `போனால் போகட்டும் என்று` as 'saying, "Let it go!"'.
scan p.29 illustration: corrected the main caption from plural 'strikes' to singular 'the strike' for `வேலைநிறுத்தத்தின் விளைவாலும்`.

scan p.31: corrected the farmer-meeting duration from an erroneous clock-time reading ('until nearly 2 or 2½') to 'for nearly two or two-and-a-half hours from 10 o'clock' for `10 மணியிலிருந்து கிட்டத்தட்ட 2 அல்லது 2½ மணி நேரம்`.

scan p.36: replaced the normalized administrative rendering 'Scheduled communities' with source-close 'oppressed people' for `தாழ்த்தப்பட்ட மக்கள்`; likewise retained `பிற்படுத்தப்பட்ட மக்கள்` as 'backward people'.
scan p.37→38: restored the source-page boundary in Thiru Subbu's intervention; the Gate-F English had moved the opening continuation from scan 38 into scan 37.

scan p.38: removed the unsupported extra category 'author' from the opening phrase `எந்தப் புத்தகமானாலும், ஒரு கட்சியை யானாலும்`; the author/leader/writer/party-person list remains only where the source actually gives it.
scan p.39→40: restored the source-page boundary inside the `ஆரிய மாயை` verse; four lines printed at the top of scan 40 had been incorrectly placed under source page 39 in Gate F.
translation.completion_note: Prior Gate F/G/H work remains historically documented, but the newly recovered Tamil crop text requires corresponding English repair and a fresh fidelity/integrity recheck before release status can be restored.
